cleanup.barriers: None needed on the sheltered west (leeward) coast; the wild east coast is unprotected.
cleanup.cleanup: Municipal ZOFEMAT crews and SEMAR; east-coast beaches cleared irregularly.
cleanup.resort: West-side resorts rake piers and small beaches daily.
cleanup.speed: same-day west; days to never on east coast

safety.advisory: US State Dept: Quintana Roo, Level 2 (exercise increased caution)
notes: Strong drift currents on reef dives; dive with licensed operators.
East (windward) coast has dangerous rip currents: swim only at protected spots like Chen Río.
Cruise-ship days crowd San Miguel downtown.

tourism: Palancar & Columbia reefs (Arrecifes de Cozumel NP)
